summary.headline: HYBE acquires 280,853,801 HYBE Americas shares via in-kind contribution, KRW 378.2bn
summary.what_happened: HYBE Co., Ltd. contributed 861,004 common shares of Dunamu Inc. in kind to its wholly owned subsidiary HYBE Americas Inc. (HBA) and, in return, subscribed to common shares newly issued by HBA through a rights offering. Following the correction filed on Nov 24, 2026, the acquisition date is Nov 24, 2026, and HYBE's post-acquisition holding is 1,769,153,801 shares, equal to 100% of HBA.
summary.why_it_matters: Filings of this type report a company's acquisition of shares in another company, often through a capital increase or in-kind contribution within a corporate group. For shareholders in Korea, such filings typically disclose how investment assets are moved between group entities and the scale of the transaction relative to the company's balance sheet.
